title: The omnidirectional trace in H 1 ($Ω$)
summary: We first prove that all the functions in L 2 whose directional derivative is in L 2 have a directional trace on the boundary of any open bounded domain, without assumptions on its regularity. This enables us to define the omnidirectional trace of the elements of the Sobolev space H 1 ($Ω$) for which there exists a function on the boundary that is almost everywhere equal, with respect to the directional measure, to the directional trace, regardless of the direction.
